Package de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin

Class AfterLogoutRedirectToIdp

java.lang.Object
de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin.AfterLogoutRedirectToIdp
All Implemented Interfaces:
sonia.scm.api.v2.resources.LogoutRedirection
@Extension public class AfterLogoutRedirectToIdp extends Object implements sonia.scm.api.v2.resources.LogoutRedirection
Performs an RP-initiated logout at the identity provider, if the configuration flag "ssoLogout" is set. The id token of the login is passed as id_token_hint together with a post_logout_redirect_uri, so the identity provider can terminate the matching SSO session without a confirmation prompt and redirect the browser back to SCM-Manager.

Without the hint keycloak shows a "do you really want to log out" page and stays there, which is why the id token is kept in the IdTokenStore for exactly this moment.

Nothing in here may throw: the local logout has already happened when this hook is called, so a failure would leave the user in a half logged out state. Every problem therefore results in an empty optional, which means "no redirect".
